Media Purge — rule-based media cleanup for Plex and Jellyfin. This repository publishes a single app: **Media Purge**, an unraid container that scans your libraries, produces explainable delete recommendations (never watched, watched years ago, duplicates, low quality, dead series...), and reclaims storage through a staged, reversible pipeline (approve → recycle bin → purge after a retention window). Dry-run is on by default.
For support, bug reports, or feature requests, please use the GitHub issue tracker linked below.
